purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Myanmar's official Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD) is the evidenced national land-record custodian, with Bago Region Government providing local administrative context. The SLRD page returned an anonymous Cloudflare challenge, and a public ArcGIS directory exposed no parcel/cadastral service. No safe Pegu native parcel identity plus polygon was verified; no sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: National SLRD custody is evidenced by its official site and land-record/map materials. The official Bago Region Government page provides Bago district/township context and a district map image. Neither source was verified as an open Pegu parcel-vector endpoint or local registry API.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Settlement and Land Records Department, Myanmar
officialPrimarySources.observation: Official national department site; references departmental records/maps and geodatabase analysis, but no public Pegu parcel endpoint was exposed in the bounded anonymous request.
Official local government page for Bago Township with a Bago district map image and township navigation; no cadastral parcel API or parcel attributes.
Directory lists general Myanmar boundaries, transport, census and other services; no parcel/cadastral layer was listed.
